text: {"features":[{"name":"Relevant production experience","description":"This rates how strongly the letter shows directly relevant professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes only the lowest end of relevant experience seen here, around the minimum required years and a very small set of launched services, with limited sense of scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows either somewhat more years or somewhat more shipped services than the weakest letters, but still limited breadth across production work overall."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid mid-range experience, typically including several years and multiple production systems across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong professional depth through repeated launches and ongoing ownership of multiple services over a sustained period."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest experience in the pool by combining long tenure with a large set of production services and clear end-to-end responsibility."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"This rates the level and role-relevance of the applicant's formal technical education as presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States only a baseline bachelor's degree or equivalent and leaves it as a minimum credential."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's degree or equivalent and connects it to stronger technical preparation, but without advanced graduate study."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a relevant master's degree or equivalent advanced technical study."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a relevant doctorate or other clearly research-level technical training."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents research-level training and makes its relevance to the role especially clear through technically mature framing in the letter."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"This rates how convincingly the letter establishes strong professional ability building backend systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or without evidence that it is a meaningful working language."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says Go is used professionally but gives little detail about backend responsibilities or depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular professional Go use on production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language and links it to concrete backend design or implementation work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to a clear track record of building and operating production backend systems, often as the main language in several role-relevant projects."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"This rates how convincingly the letter shows meaningful professional Python experience relevant to tooling, automation, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no direct Python evidence or only a very weak implication of familiarity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly with little scope, depth, or seriousness."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular professional Python use for tooling, services, or internal automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive Python experience across multiple contexts such as services, analysis, automation, or test infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade and heavily relied upon, with clear evidence that important tooling or systems built in Python are used by others."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"This rates the strength of direct experience building or shipping AI features relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no direct AI experience relevant to shipped software."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in AI or mentions only limited experimentation without real deployment."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes shipped AI or LLM features at a basic level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work with explicit attention to reliability, evaluation, guardrails, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial role-relevant AI experience that combines shipped features with clear mechanisms for making them trustworthy in production."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems architecture","description":"This rates how strongly the letter demonstrates direct design or implementation of agent-based systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of agentic systems work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation vaguely without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states experience building agentic workflows or multi-step agents."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agents were structured, constrained, or integrated with services, often across Python and Go components."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deliberate architectural ownership of bounded, auditable agents supported by backend infrastructure and clear control mechanisms."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"This rates the strength of direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related security response work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no direct vulnerability-handling automation experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses broad interest in security automation but gives no concrete vulnerability-work example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some direct experience automating parts of vulnerability handling, report flow, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly owns tooling that classifies, deduplicates, routes, or otherwise reduces manual vulnerability triage work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a compelling end-to-end automation story that turned a manual vulnerability queue into a substantially more self-running process."}]},{"name":"Security assessment capability","description":"This rates how convincingly the letter demonstrates the ability to perform practical security assessments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no direct assessment experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows indirect security exposure but unclear personal involvement in assessments."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment activities such as threat modeling, code review, or review of internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows multiple hands-on assessment modes across design or release cycles with some follow-through on findings or fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong assessment credibility through structured, builder-minded reviews that include attack-surface analysis, remediation validation, or repeated formal assessments."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"This rates the strength of evidence for practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a generic claim of strength with little or no supporting example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one clear practical example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong application of algorithms or data structures to nontrivial performance or correctness problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates especially deep fluency through sophisticated redesigns or hard problems made tractable by better algorithmic choices."}]},{"name":"External security credibility","description":"This rates the strength of outside signals that the applicant has invested seriously in security practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no outside security signal beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a light signal such as casual security practice or a weakly framed credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful outside security commitment through regular capture-the-flag participation or a foundational certification such as Security+."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong external credibility through high-level capture-the-flag results or a hands-on credential such as OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines a highly credible hands-on security signal with sustained strong offensive practice or similarly compelling external validation."}]},{"name":"Mission understanding","description":"This rates how well the letter shows understanding of the specific charter of this Information Security Engineering team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Speaks about security in broad terms without showing awareness of this team's specific responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Picks up only one surface-level theme from the posting, such as security or automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reflects a basic grasp of the charter by referencing at least one concrete responsibility like vulnerability response or lifecycle tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates several core elements of the team's work, such as scaling security processes, automating triage, assisting developers, or pairing Go backends with Python agents."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of the team's leverage at Google by framing the work as foundational security infrastructure that amplifies scarce expertise across many teams."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"This rates how strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping other engineers work more safely with less friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames security mostly as personal interest, defense, or prestige rather than as service to other engineers."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping others only briefly or abstractly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Treats security tooling as a way to reduce manual work or support developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes removing friction, making the secure path the easy path, or building defaults that engineers will actually use."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently shows deep empathy for developer workflows and frames security engineering as enabling others to move faster and more safely."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"This rates how persuasive and role-specific the applicant's stated motivation is.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives a generic desire to join the company or work in security with little role-specific reasoning."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows sincere interest but only a limited personal connection to this specific role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains a believable reason the role fits the applicant's background or direction."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties the role to a clear personal trajectory, engineering philosophy, or prior experience."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes a highly persuasive case that this role is the natural next step, grounded in specific past work and a credible sense of purpose."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"This rates how concrete and observable the supporting evidence is throughout the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on abstract claims and aspirations, with few concrete technologies, tasks, or examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specific nouns or tasks, but many claims still rest on generic assertions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses several concrete examples to support the main claims, though not all are equally detailed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports most major claims with specific role-relevant detail that makes the letter easy to trust."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Substantiates nearly every major claim with rich, concrete evidence about work done, technologies used, or problems solved."}]},{"name":"Demonstrated ownership","description":"This rates how clearly the letter shows first-person responsibility for meaningful work and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads more as interest or participation than as personal responsibility for outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some contribution but leaves ownership, scope, or results unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly claims direct responsibility for at least one meaningful system, tool, or improvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly presents first-person ownership of important work and links it to operational value."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently shows end-to-end ownership of consequential systems or automation with clear evidence of leverage or measured benefit."}]},{"name":"Personal technical ambition","description":"This rates how much the letter shows self-directed technical initiative through substantive work outside the main job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no outside work or only very small hobby projects with little technical challenge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a modest side project that shows initiative but limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear personal build that required real effort or follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial self-directed systems project with meaningful infrastructure, distributed, or reliability complexity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually ambitious technical initiative through a sustained, hard personal build that tackles nontrivial systems problems from first principles."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"This rates how strongly the letter shows contribution to or maintenance of open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only passive use or vague interest in open source."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Cites occasional upstream patches or bug fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution or active maintenance responsibility for a project or library."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates clear stewardship, such as maintainership, release management, or community responsibility for software used beyond the applicant's own team."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"This rates the polish of spelling, grammar, and sentence-level execution.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling or usage errors that repeatedly distract from the substance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has several noticeable mistakes that reduce polish but do not block understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few errors or awkward phrasings yet remains comfortably readable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished with only isolated minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]},{"name":"Structural coherence","description":"This rates how well the letter is organized into a clear, persuasive progression.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels loosely assembled, with abrupt jumps or a weak through-line connecting the claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is understandable but reads mostly as a list of facts with limited narrative flow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear overall structure, though some transitions or emphasis could be stronger."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized and easy to follow, with a logical progression from motivation to evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally coherent, using structure and transitions to build a compelling case step by step."}]}]}
